column3: NKJV begins with “Then I stood on the sand of the sea” (critical text 12:18, “he stood”) and has “a blasphemous name,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “blasphemous names.”
NKJV lacks “and people,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text includes it.
NKJV has “He who leads into captivity … he who kills with the sword,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “If anyone is for captivity … if anyone is to be killed with the sword.”
